rationale_overall: Every incumbent posted strong, wave-consistent news this quarter with no thesis breach: MSFT (FQ3'24 revenue +17%, Cloud +23%, Copilot traction), NVDA (blockbuster Q4 FY24 print, GTC 2024 keynote extending the AI/robotics roadmap), LMT (Q1'24 sales +14%; the sole US defense-prime the profile explicitly asks to hold, and defense/geopolitical tailwinds stayed live via Red Sea rerouting and a ~12% early-2024 rally in ITA), RKLB (won its largest-ever contract, the $515M Space Development Agency Tranche 2 Beta award, Jan 31 2024), and IONQ (Q1 revenue beat, 2024 bookings guidance raised). Pass-1 surfaced one strong candidate outside the set: Intuitive Machines (LUNR), whose Odysseus lander achieved the first US lunar soft landing since Apollo on 2024-02-22, hitting the profile's #1 next wave. But the watchlist is at its 5-ticker cap, an add requires a paired remove, and none of the five incumbents shows a fundamental breach — removing LMT (the only defense-prime) or RKLB (already covering the rockets bucket LUNR would join) would fight the profile's own instructions. Net effect: watchlist unchanged (MSFT/NVDA/LMT/RKLB/IONQ); LUNR flagged for a future rebalance.
